entries.title: Supercurrent enables the reading of quantum information without destroying it
entries.summary: One of the fundamental challenges of quantum computing is obtaining information from a quantum bit, or qubit. Unlike a conventional bit, which can be read repeatedly without altering its content, direct measurement of a quantum system typically causes the state to collapse…

entries.title: Patterns of polar vortices discovered in lead-free superlattices on silicon
